{{Item infobox | type = Trophy | material type = Mystic | description = A [[Gift of Metal|gift of metal]] used to create generation one and two [[legendary weapon]]s and the [[legendary back item]] [[Ad Infinitum]].

Purchase the recipe for this item from any [[Mystic Forge]] vendor and reach a [[weaponsmith]] rating of 400 to craft. | rarity = Legendary | value = 640 | bound = Account | collection = Legendary Weapon: Bolt; Legendary Weapon: Frostfang; Legendary Weapon: Incinerator; Legendary Weapon: Kamohoali'i Kotaki; Legendary Weapon: Klobjarne Geirr Gifts; Legendary Weapon: Sunrise; Legendary Weapon: The Flameseeker Prophecies; Legendary Weapon: The Juggernaut; Legendary Weapon: The Moot; Legendary Weapon: Twilight | id = 19621 }} [[Gift of Metal]] is a [[gift]] used to craft the first and second set of [[legendary weapon]]s, as well as the [[Legendary back item|legendary backpiece]] [[Ad Infinitum]], and [[Klobjarne Geirr]]. == Acquisition == === Sold by === {{Sold by}} === Recipe === {{Recipe | source = recipe sheet | sheet = Recipe: Gift of Metal | type = Crafting Component | disciplines = weaponsmith | rating = 400 | ingredient1 = 250 Orichalcum Ingot | ingredient2 = 250 Mithril Ingot | ingredient3 = 250 Darksteel Ingot | ingredient4 = 250 Platinum Ingot | id = 6074 }} == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Currency for == {{Vendor query table|currency=Gift of Metal}} == Related achievements == * {{collection achievement|Lessons in Metallurgy}} — ''Take a [[Gift of Metal]] to the [[Champion Weapons Test Engineer|dredge weaponsmith]]'s [[workbench]] located in the [[Molten Furnace Fractal]].'' == Notes == * Despite being a [[Weaponsmith]]ing recipe, Gift of Metal requires {{item icon|Platinum Ingot}}s, which can only be crafted by {{jeweler}} [[Jeweler]]s and {{scribe}} [[Scribe]]s. They can also be bought at the Trading Post. [[de:Gabe des Metalls]] [[es:Don del metal]] [[fr:Don de métal]]
title: Gift of Metal
